findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be missing at both bathroom hand sinks. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

(REPEAT) Observed no test strips for the quaternary ammonium and the Purell spray bottle. Discussed with PIC. Ensure test strips are bought for each type of sanitizer. Repeat from pre-opening on 11/21/23. Inspector will follow-up on 1/15/24.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following physical facility repairs that need to be completed:
1. Caulking at both hand sinks in the bathrooms (no caulk between the walls and sinks).
2. Mop sink needs caulked to the wall (missing caulking around the basin).
3. Dry wall directly above the mop sink basin needs repaired (fraying - needs to be smooth and easily cleanable).

Discussed repairs with PIC. Repair by next routine inspection. #1-2 are repeat violations since the pre-opening inspection on 11/21/23.
